questions.question: Please identify a specific Bulgarian problem collection or competition source supporting the explanation of the conventional title “A problem from Bulgaria”. If no such source is available, please remove or qualify that explanation in both editions; the author’s title itself should be preserved.

Если такого источника нет, нужно убрать или осторожнее сформулировать это пояснение в обеих версиях; авторское название материала при этом сохраняется.

questions.resolution: Both editions retain the author’s title and explicitly state that its origin is unknown; the unsupported explanation was removed.
